name: B10-0531/2026 (PPE) – Case of Eritrean Swedish journalist Dawit Isaak, arbitrarily detained in Eritrea
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Eritrean-Swedish journalist Dawit Isaak, arbitrarily detained in Eritrea
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of Dawit Isaak, a journalist with Eritrean and Swedish citizenship. He was arrested in Eritrea in September 2001 and has been held for 25 years without ever being charged with a crime. The Parliament asks Eritrea to prove he is alive, let doctors and Swedish officials see him, and free him so he can return to Sweden. It also condemns Eritrea's wider record of holding people without trial.

- Nothing changes in law; this is the Parliament's public appeal to Eritrea and other bodies.
- It concerns Dawit Isaak, his family, and other people held in Eritrea without trial.
- The Parliament sends its demand to Eritrea, the African Union, the United Nations and European Union bodies.
